report_identity.report_title: Enterprise Development Holdings Limited Annual Report 2023

business_overview.one_sentence: The Group sells software licenses and other products and provides integrated business software solutions, mainly through software maintenance and other services.
business_overview.revenue_model: Revenue comes from software maintenance and other services recognised over time and software licenses/other products recognised at a point in time.
business_notes: 2023 software maintenance and other services revenue was RMB36.251 million.
2023 sale of software license and other products revenue was RMB24.395 million.
Contract assets rose because maintenance and other services were provided toward year end before unconditional billing rights.
